## Historical audit — S0199

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/service_incident_01/retired/results/r1/fixed_h0/H0/test/commons_199974832/trajectory.jsonl`. Offsets below refer to the supplied decoded JSONL observations.

| Evidence | Observation and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Student `model_request`, line 1, chars [0,5609) | The assigned goal was to reconstruct an indoor photograph as separate 3D meshes, matching geometry, placement, colors, materials, camera and framing. The prompt required a runnable SceneAct/Blender program and prohibited using the reference as a texture or background. The reference image itself is not visible in this audit, so its actual contents cannot be characterized. |
| Student `codex_session`, line 2, chars [0,2614) | A fresh, read-only session was launched with the staged image; it failed with exit code 1 after about 19.6 seconds. It reports zero tool calls. The record exposes one CLI turn but not every underlying inference round. |
| Student `model_error`, line 3, chars [0,538); `scene_error`, line 4, chars [0,1601) | The failure propagated through the request and scene harness. The cited stderr path is not its contents, so the underlying cause is unknown. No program, scene edit, render, visual inspection, score, or successful build is shown. This is a **technical interruption**, not evidence of an algorithmic failure, partial correctness, an empty patch, or formal success. |

**Scene checks:** The goal called for multiple objects and materials, but the trace provides no visible geometry to verify object count, textures, part connections, pose, or camera, lighting and render quality. The requested camera matching is a goal, not an observed result.

**Teacher and exploration:** No teacher input, detection, diagnosis, proposed update, execution or adoption is recorded; availability cannot be treated as receipt. No autonomous tool exploration is visible. A CLI turn alone does not establish what reasoning occurred.

**Lessons and uncertainty:** Transferably, a failed model invocation can prevent any reconstruction or validation, and exit status alone does not diagnose its cause. The image path, execution environment and stated scene constraints are specific to this attempt. Whether stderr would reveal the cause, whether any unrecorded inference occurred, and what the reference depicts remain unresolved.
